Vendored texture2ddecoder-wasm 1.2.6 (MIT), from https://github.com/fatal10110/unity-asset-reader (npm release).
Only the generated loader and WASM are included. Node loads bundled bytes explicitly; no CDN, package installation or network access at runtime.
